shell_commands: /bin/zsh -lc "cat src/infrastructure/stores/inMemorySessionStore.ts; cat src/transport/ws/validation.ts; rg -n 'specs/.*#' src/transport/*.test.ts | head; cat jest.config.js"

/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n 'specs/.*#|@spec' src/transport/sessionResume.test.ts scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs; cat src/transport/createServer.ts | head -100; cat src/types/sessionStore.ts | head -100; cat .prettierrc"
/bin/zsh -lc "git diff --stat; rg -n '"'^it'"\\(' src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts; ls scripts/spec-links/reanchor.mjs; cat scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs | head -100"
/bin/zsh -lc "rg -n 'specs/["'^ ]*#[0-9]'"' src | head; git status --short; git log origin/main --oneline --all --grep='#144' -5"
/bin/zsh -lc 'git branch -a --contains 4c26b5f; git show --stat --oneline 4c26b5f | head -35; git log -1 --oneline origin/main; git status -sb'

/bin/zsh -lc "git checkout -- specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md
python3 - <<'PY'
p='specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md'
with open(p,'a') as f:
 f.write('''\\n## Conversation lists\\n\\nA "'`list_conversations` request accepts an optional integer `limit` from 1 to 200 and an optional `before` cursor containing a parseable ISO `updatedAt` and a `sessionId`; malformed fields are rejected, and unrelated fields are ignored ([validated by: validates conversation list requests and their composite cursors](../../src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts#L11)).'"\\n\\nWhen history is enabled, the server answers a request with one "'`conversation_list` containing only the authenticated connection user'"'s summaries, with ISO timestamps and no conversation content; it never trusts a user id in the frame ([validated by: delivers only the authenticated user’s summaries when history is enabled](../../src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts#L72)).\\n\\nWhen history is disabled, the server answers a list request with an "'`UNSUPPORTED` error ([validated by: refuses a conversation list when history is disabled](../../src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts#L87)).'"\\n''')
PY
 git add .lore/dod.md src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md
 git commit -m 'test(transport): define conversation list acceptance'"
